class.name: NNConsiderationGroup
class.brief_description: Combines multiple child considerations into a single score.
class.description: Add as a child of an [NNBehaviour], [NNBehaviourGroup], or another [NNConsiderationGroup] to aggregate several considerations using [member evaluation_method] (for example, taking the maximum of two alternative reasons to flee, or inverting a combined score with [member invert_score]). Groups can be nested arbitrarily deep.

members.member: How child consideration scores are combined. Defaults to [constant NoodleNodes.EVALUATION_MULTIPLY].
If [code]true[/code], inverts the combined score ([code]1.0 - score[/code]).
